notes_for_editor: Brief location conflict is unresolved. The brief's lat/lon (44.98242, -115.39278, from ffla) is about 2.6 km from the brief's idaho_fl point (44.9963, -115.36567). The Archival Idaho record (source 4) gives 44.996938, -115.358934, about 0.5 km from the idaho_fl point. No source states the lookout's own coordinates, so the brief record was not changed. The Archival Idaho record's catalogue date is 1910, which predates the 1935 build; that date is not used in the story or as evidence and may be a catalogue error. No photo added to the photos list: the direct image URL was not retrieved, only the record page.
